story.title: Maple Street Café

subjects.words: the café storefront with a navy and cream striped awning, wooden door and windows, and small wooden bistro tables and chairs on the pavement
a latte with a white foam heart and a green leaf in a white cup on a white saucer, on a round white marble table
golden croissants on trays in a glass display case on a wooden counter, with baristas working behind
